subject: Request to reinstate legacy promotional credits for FinOps Labs
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@finops.io>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: colin@lunaris.ai
Date: 2027-05-14T09:12:00Z
Subject: legacy promo credits — ask to reopen sandbox access

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from our side. We had a small pilot with Redwood last summer under a promotional code (reference: FINOPS23-RED) and the credits expired while we were mid-eval. We just finished procurement and have a PO ready, but the sandbox is locked and the original promo code appears to be expired.

Would it be possible to get a one-time reinstatement of the leftover promo credits or a short-term top-up while the PO clears? The sandbox contains our eval artifacts and restoring it would save us hours rehydrating tests.

I’ve attached the PO for visibility (finops_po_20270513.pdf) and the original promo terms (promo_terms_2023.pdf). Happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Ops, FinOps Labs
-- attachment: finops_po_20270513.pdf (PDF, 128KB)
-- attachment: promo_terms_2023.pdf (PDF, 48KB)
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@finops.io>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-14T12:05:00Z
Subject: Re: legacy promo credits — ask to reopen sandbox access

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and the PO.

Quick summary of options so we’re aligned:
- Short-term solution (fast): issue a one-time sandbox top-up equivalent to the unused portion of FINOPS23-RED (up to 15k tokens) while procurement clears. We’ll mark it as a conditional credit (audit trail + expiry in 14 days).
- Medium-term (preferred): apply a temporary allowance to your account and schedule a small maintenance window to unlock the sandbox for 48 hours so you can export artifacts.
- If you need a longer runway we can convert to a promo code extension but that requires RevOps sign-off.

To proceed with the fast path I need: (1) confirmation from your procurement owner that the PO is being routed, and (2) written acceptance of the conditional 14-day expiry on the top-up. If that’s fine I’ll route for approval and loop in RevOps for provisioning.

I’ve drafted a short internal memo that outlines the one-time credit and the audit tags (one-time-credit-memo.pdf) — attaching here for transparency.

Regards,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182
-- attachment: one-time-credit-memo.pdf (PDF, 24KB)
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, Elena Morales <elena@finops.io>
Date: 2027-05-15T08:22:00Z
Subject: Re: legacy promo credits — ask to reopen sandbox access

Jasmine — fine with a one-time 15k token conditional top-up and 14-day expiry. Note for the record: scope it to sandbox-only, add the audit tag "legacy-recall-D-32941" and include a short usage note in the account so CS can follow up. If procurement finalizes the PO within the window we’ll convert and remove the expiry.

Ben — can you queue provisioning with the ops playbook and guard rails?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Revenue Operations
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@finops.io>

- apply the credit to the FinOps Labs account with tag legacy-recall-D-32941
- set expiration to 2027-05-31T02:00:00Z (14 days)
- lock it to sandbox-only resources
- drop an event in the account timeline and send the audit log to both revenueops@redwood.ai and finops_ops@finops.io

Thanks,
Ben Carter

From: Elena Morales <elena@finops.io>

Thanks all — confirmed. Procurement routed the PO (FinOps Labs PO #5561) to legal yesterday; we expect final sign-off by 5/20. Colin Park from our infra team will be on the 5/17 window to validate.

We accept the conditional 14-day top-up tied to that audit tag. Please proceed.

Appreciate the quick help — this will save us rehydration time and keep the eval on track.

Best,
Elena
